task.title: Delete Your Saved Autofill Form Information in Chrome
task.shortdesc: Delete all of your saved addresses, payment methods, and other autofill form information in Chrome at the same time.

context.p: To delete all of your addresses, payment methods, or other saved info in Chrome at the same time:

step.cmd: In the top right, select More.
Choose a time range, such as Last hour or All time.
Under Advanced, choose Autofill form data.
